credits.title: The Child
credits.overview: The story of Mariaje and Nicasio, the mother and grandfather of one of the children who died in a gas explosion in a town in the Basque Country in October 1980. On a journey marked by unexpected emotions, Mariaje and Nicasio search for - and find - their own unique way to overcome their loss.

credits.title: Siege (Asedio)
credits.overview: During an eviction procedure in a troubled area of Madrid, police officer Dani makes a shocking discovery.

credits.title: Descarrilados
credits.overview: Three lifelong 40-year-old friends go on a huge Interrail tour to honor their recently deceased friend.

credits.title: Ane Is Missing
credits.overview: Lide works the night shift for the construction company in charge of a new high-speed train network, a project that has attracted protests and violent attacks. One morning she wakes up to discover that her teenage daughter, Ane, is nowhere to be found.

credits.title: The Night Watchman
credits.overview: Jack wants to prove to his wife Alma, that he is a new man after his drug abuse and time spend in prison. He is offered new job as a night watchman of an old mine complex, which he accepts without a question. What no one knows that the dark place holds a disturbing secret that will fill their lives with terror.

credits.title: Perro Liquen
credits.overview: A young guy goes to the mountains to explore and create his own martial art. By Miguel Llansó

credits.title: Rage
credits.overview: A romantic thriller about a construction worker in hiding for killing his foreman who hides in the mansion where his girlfriend works as a maid.
